messages:
Lina: Quick heads-up — during last night's private deploy failover the keystore flipped to the DR HSM and we have ~45m missing audit events forwarded to Splunk. Not sure if the agent crashed or the forwarder was blocked. Anyone watching?
Sam: Which cluster/region? ops-bot entries?
Lina: eu-west-1 private-vpc-3. ops-bot shows keystore health transition at 02:14Z and a log-forwarder restart around 02:16Z. Nothing until 03:01Z.
ops-bot: [automated] keystore.health.changed cluster=private-vpc-3 from=primary to=secondary at=2026-11-02T02:14:09Z
Maya: Any netpol/firewall/NAT rotations in that window?
Carol (infra): No manual netpol changes in infra-audit. I see the forwarder autoscaler scaled one replica down at 02:15 and back up — might have lost an in-memory buffer.
Eli: Forwarder uses ephemeral queue on private clusters intentionally for lower I/O. If pod died during HSM handover we likely lost buffered events.
Sam: That points to a durability gap, not crypto. But check whether a policy rejected events during the keystore principal swap.
security-oncall: Incident INC-2026-1423 opened. Triage owners: @Lina, @Carol, @Maya.
Maya: Short-term: patch daemonset to mount a PVC for forwarder queue (1Gi) and enable at-least-once delivery. Can we patch without full deploy?
Carol (infra): Yes — patch command below. Note: need to create PVC first.
kubectl patch daemonset log-forwarder -n infra -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name": "forwarder", "volumeMounts": [{"name": "persist-queue", "mountPath": "/var/queue"}]}], "volumes": [{"name": "persist-queue", "persistentVolumeClaim": {"claimName": "log-forwarder-pvc"}}]}}}}'
Sam: Also verify RBAC for svc-logs-forwarder. During keystore failover the keystore principal changes and our IRSA token rotation can create a short-lived permission mismatch.
Lina: Current SA: svc-logs-forwarder@infra. Does it keep splunk:ingest perms via log-ingest-role?
Eli: It binds to log-ingest-role via IRSA. The role wasn't removed, but the token sync lag during HSM handoff can cause 403s.
Maya: Mitigation proposal: on keystore failover, delay forwarder restarts until queue persistence is confirmed, or ensure forwarder can access old envelope keys for a grace period.
Carol (infra): Ops suggestion: keystore controller should call a pre-shutdown webhook to drain/checkpoint forwarder state before switching. I'll add that to infra PR.
Lina: Forensics checklist: 1) export HSM transition events, 2) collect node/pod logs for forwarder 02:00-03:30, 3) check Splunk for accepted vs dropped events, 4) verify audit log sequence numbers near 02:14.
Sam: Splunk query to find seq gaps:
index=infra_logs source=\"keystore-audit\" cluster=\"private-vpc-3\" earliest=\"02:00\" latest=\"03:30\" | sort 0 _time | table _time event_id seqnum

Eli: Also inspect keystore server logs for auth errors — if keystore returned 403 the forwarder probably dropped events silently.
security-oncall: Reminder: private on-prem retention for audit logs is 365 days. Snapshot raw storage before any compaction.
Maya: Long-term changes: require durable forwarder queue for private deployments, narrow service account privileges (least privilege), and schedule canary keystore failovers during low-traffic windows.
Carol (infra): I'll open infra PR enabling PVC + pre-shutdown drain webhook + netpol ensuring egress only to Splunk. Sample NetworkPolicy snippet to restrict forwarder egress:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-splunk-egress
  namespace: infra
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: log-forwarder
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 198.51.100.0/24
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8088

Lina: Security action items: 1) Add keystore failover scenario to incident tabletop and update runbook to require forwarder persistence; 2) Audit RBAC transient revocations during HSM handover and create a backstop to prevent role-binding flips mid-failover.
Sam: I'll own #2 — will simulate failover in sandbox and capture role-binding state transitions.
security-oncall: Track remediation in INC-2026-1423. Please post PR links and the postmortem here once available. :thumbsup:
Lina: Thanks all. Ping if you find evidence of dropped PII-level events.
ops-bot: [automated] Incident INC-2026-1423 created by security-oncall at 2026-11-02T04:02:11Z
Carol (infra): PR infra#3124 opened to add PVC + drain hook + netpol. ETA review: 6h.
Maya: Marking this thread resolved for now until PR merges. :white_check_mark:
